text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall descend upon the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Last year as the resurrected, 
and this year as the God of Destruction!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My trial is a duel two years in a row! The 
Goddess of Fate may be cruel, but she 
never bores me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I surely longed for this very 
moment. Long before the creation of heaven 
and earth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us fulfill the promise from an 
eternity ago. Face me... "Symboli Kris 
S"...!
